primary_source.note: The endpoint form was verified against a live entry before any bulk download; a failing record is never assumed to mean a wrong URL pattern.

cache.rule: Raw coordinates are never embedded in application data or in a Git-ready payload.

download_behaviour.partial_download_cleanup: a file is written to a .part path and renamed only after the gzip stream decodes and the entry id matches
response_validation: data_ block matches the requested id
download_behaviour.deterministic_failure_list: failures are sorted by pdb_id and recorded with reason

unavailable_policy: A structure without coordinates is retained in the manifest with coordinate_availability = coordinate_unavailable and an explicit reason. The two RCSB-metadata-absent entries are never silently removed.

coordinate_context.default_conditions: the annotated receptor and ligand entities are both present in the deposited coordinates and their chains are consistent with the source annotation
forbidden: automatically choose the nearest symmetry copy as the ligand
choose the assembly that yields the most contacts
assembly_audit_triggers: ligand annotated in the source but showing no plausible geometric proximity to the receptor
polymer ligand brought adjacent to the receptor only by an assembly operation
asymmetric unit contains several copies of the complex
one entity yields many symmetry or assembly instances
